title: Temporary access review for Fleet Console

sections.heading: Request
paragraphs: Request ACC-662. Customer Enablement needs read-only access to the Northmere Produce pilot tenant to confirm device enrollment. The approval is restricted to tenant metadata and diagnostic views.

sections.heading: Decision
paragraphs: Approved by the Fleet Console service owner for a two-hour window on 13 October. Raw sensor history and billing access remain outside the approved scope.

sections.heading: Evidence
paragraphs: The requester records the grant ID, action performed, and validation screenshots in the restricted case. The access reviewer confirms expiry before closing ACC-662.
